formate.intro: CELI 1 is the CELI exam for A2. CELI Impatto is the A1 exam. As far as we know it has four parts: reading and language competence, writing, listening and speaking. The numbers of tasks, timings, scoring and the pass rule are to verify on the official page: this site does not state them as fact. The CELI numbering (Impatto, 1–5) is also to verify.
